stimulus.title: My New Fish
stimulus.bodyText: Last Saturday my father and I went to the pet shop in our town. I wanted a dog, but our flat is very small and dogs need a garden. So I got two little fish. They are orange and white. Their home is a big glass bowl on my desk, next to my computer. I give them food two times a day. My little sister talks to the fish every evening. She calls them Sun and Cloud. I think they are happy with us.

stimulus.title: The Red Umbrella
stimulus.bodyText: On Monday it rained all day. Lin had a new red umbrella. After school she went to the small shop with her mother. In the shop Lin put her umbrella next to the door. Then she and her mother walked home in the rain and got very wet. 'Where is your umbrella?' asked her mother. 'Oh no! It is in the shop,' said Lin. The next day the shop woman gave the umbrella back. Now Lin keeps her umbrella in her school bag every day.

questions.prompt: What is the story mainly about?

Who gave the umbrella back to Lin?
Where does Lin keep her umbrella now?

stimulus.title: A Cake for Grandma
stimulus.bodyText: It was Grandma's birthday. Ella and her mother made a cake in the kitchen. They put eggs, milk and two bananas in a big blue bowl. The cake was very hot, so it sat on the table for one hour. Then Ella made a card. She put a big yellow sun on it. At five o'clock Grandma came to the house. She ate two pieces of cake and looked at the card three times. 'This is the best birthday,' she said.
